prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE photorealistic animation sprite sheet, 4 columns by 3 rows, exactly 12 equal cells in chronological row-major order. Input image is the authorized reference of adult character Andy; use ONLY this person. Each cell shows the SAME Andy at identical scale, camera angle, torso location, head size, hair, black sleeveless shirt, beard, right-forearm tattoo and bracelets. Actual transparent background throughout, no table, no labels, no gridlines. Framing identical to reference with full forearms and enough side margin. Do not crop hands. The purpose is a realistic seated game avatar drinking a generic green beer bottle with blank cream label. Bottle is gripped by anatomically correct connected hand, with correct finger wrapping and occlusion. No floating props. His right arm is on viewer LEFT. His left arm stays resting. Motion sequence: 1 original resting pose, green bottle standing at far lower viewer-left within the frame; 2 right hand reaches toward that bottle, elbow and shoulder connected; 3 hand wraps around body of bottle; 4 bottle lifted just off resting surface; 5 elbow bends lifting bottle toward chest; 6 bottle rises toward mouth; 7 bottle neck touches lips and head inclines slightly; 8 he takes a sip, bottle angled naturally upward with rim at lips; 9 lowers bottle to chest; 10 lowers bottle toward far lower left edge; 11 bottle exits below lower left crop as hand returns empty; 12 exact original resting pose with BOTH hands resting, no bottle. Preserve identity and face faithfully across all 12 frames. Registered animation: no camera motion, no zoom, no whole-body drift, no facial morphing, no style changes, no added fingers, no disconnected arm. Produce photographic action keyframes, not cartoons. The action should read as pick up, drink, dispose below frame, return to rest; final cupholder would be empty. Keep every cell uniform and aligned for extraction.

Create a corrected, tightly registered animation sprite sheet using the first image as the authoritative identity reference (Andy), and the second as the action sequence to improve. Output ONE sheet with exactly 4 columns and 3 rows, 12 equal cells, landscape 16:9 overall aspect if possible, each cell 4:3. Real alpha transparency, no labels, no grid. Critical correction: EACH pose must fit completely inside its own cell with 8% empty transparent padding on all four edges; NO hands or body parts crossing into adjacent cells. Same head center at x=50% of each cell and same head top y=8%, same face size, same torso baseline y=91% across EVERY frame; do not drift sideways, zoom, or alter face. Preserve Andy's actual original facial identity, build, black sleeveless shirt, hairstyle, beard, tattooed right arm on viewer LEFT, bracelets. Preserve photorealism and lighting. Resting left hand fixed near lower right in every frame. Twelve frames row-major: 1 resting like original plus green blank-label beer bottle at lower left; 2 reach right hand toward bottle; 3 grasp bottle naturally; 4 lift bottle low; 5 bottle at chest; 6 bottle near lips; 7 rim at lips taking sip; 8 deeper sip slight head tilt allowed but no torso/camera shift; 9 lower bottle to chest; 10 place bottle below left bottom visible boundary; 11 empty hand returning to rest; 12 exact original resting pose, no bottle. Correct anatomy and finger occlusion throughout. Use modest movement in head only while sipping. Keep hand and forearm connected and tattoo coherent. The resulting separated frames must make a usable animation without registration jitter. Do NOT enlarge people to fill every edge; generous uniform empty padding is mandatory.
status: Preview only; not integrated. Head registration applied during sprite extraction, no invented intermediate poses.
limitations: Photographic keyframes still change face and torso slightly.
Elbow framing and hand transitions are not consistently smooth.
No actual cupholder pickup registration against the game scene yet.
Only Andy with a generic green beer bottle; not other opponents or cocktails.
integration: Integrated as a user-authorized test: Andy (rafael), Heineken only, when Andy wins a hand. Other opponents/drinks and reduced motion use the existing fallback. Known quality limitations accepted for testing.
